title: International Space Station USOS Potable Water Dispenser: On-Orbit Functionality Versus Design
description: The design and early on-orbit record of the original U.S. segment PWD delivered on STS-126 and activated in November 2008.

title: Exploration Potable Water Dispenser Development Direction
description: A life-support technology roadmap describing removal of stagnant flow regions and provisions for flow-through UV disinfection and alternative biocide approaches.

title: Life Support — Water Management
description: Places the Exploration PWD within NASA's broader long-duration water-management and dormancy technology portfolio.

title: Exploration Capabilities Development Technology Demonstrations: FY23 Hardware
description: A NASA program briefing identifying xPWD as life-support demonstration hardware targeted for Northrop Grumman's NG-19 mission.

title: ISS Daily Summary: xPWD Installed, Activated, and Checked Out
description: The first official operations entry after installation in EXPRESS Rack 7, with the exploration rationale and comparison to the legacy dispenser.

title: ISS Daily Summary: Leak Check, Flush, and Water Sampling
description: The hardware passed its potable-bus leak check before crew flush, sample collection, and checkout continued.

title: ISS Daily Summary: Initial Microbial Check
description: No microbial growth was identified in the first reported incubation check, while NASA explicitly withheld crew-use approval until commissioning was complete.

title: ISS Daily Summary: Coliform Results and Crew Training
description: Records evaluation of the coliform test and nominal crew-use onboard training during the commissioning campaign.

title: Leidos Deploys Potable Water System to International Space Station
description: Leidos' account of the nearly three-year design, development, test, and certification effort performed under NASA's Cargo Mission Contract.

title: New Water Dispenser Improves Water Sanitization on Station
description: NASA's summary of the demonstrated UV-disinfection approach and the decision to clear xPWD for operational station use.

title: Status of the International Space Station Water Management and Recovery System
description: A system-level follow-up explaining xPWD's removal of known dead legs, point-of-use UV reactor, dormancy objective, and September 2023 activation.

title: Leidos Awarded NASA Cargo Mission Support Contract
description: Connects the xPWD development and August 30, 2023 deployment to Leidos' continuing ISS and Artemis cargo-mission engineering work.
